title: [WIP] Fix Vercel build error during pre-rendering
body:
## Fix Vercel Build Errors

### Issues Identified:
1. **Slider TypeError**: `e.values.map is not a function` when prerendering `/docs/components/form/slider`
   - The `slider.mdx` demo passes `defaultValue: 50` as a number
   - But `SliderSchema` and the Slider component expect `defaultValue` as `number[]` (array)
   
2. **Icon "home" not found**: Icon "home" (lookup: "Home") not found in lucide-react
   - The `icons` object in lucide-react has `House` but not `Home`
   - "Home" was renamed to "House" in lucide-react's icons object

### Changes Made:
- [x] Identify the root causes of both errors
- [x] Fix slider.mdx to pass defaultValue as an array [50] instead of 50
- [x] Fix slider renderer to handle both number and array types for backward compatibility
- [x] Add icon name mapping in icon renderer to map "Home" -> "House"
- [x] Test the build locally to ensure both issues are resolved
- [x] Add documentation comments for maintainability
- [ ] Run security checks
